name: Kosasa Foundation Community-Based Environmental Stewardship (CBES) Grant
summary: Grants to Hawaii nonprofits running community-engaged projects that improve specific environmental conditions and protect natural resources and island ecosystems. Standard grants up to $50,000, with larger multiyear grants for complex projects.

amount.note: Up to $50,000 for projects of up to 18 months; multiyear grants up to $100,000 a year, $200,000 over two years.

eligibility.rule: Is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, or a fiscal sponsor applying for a project without 501(c)(3) status
Keep annual grant funding at or below 20% of the annual operating budget
Avoid the listed excluded costs, projects and activities

documents: Fiscal sponsor's organizational budget, if applying through a fiscal sponsor
Fiscal sponsor's board information, if applying through a fiscal sponsor

calls.label: 2027 CBES round

status.quote: As of November 4, 2026, the questionnaire is disabled while we evaluate the funding opportunities Kosasa Foundation will offer in 2027. It will be available again by December 5, 2026.

deadline.quote: All applications will open about two months before the deadline and must be submitted in the portal by 5PM HST on the bolded dates below November 2026 - January 15, 2027 Capital Requests February 2027 - April 9, 2027 Culture & Arts: Creative Capacity May 2027 - July 30, 2027 Community Based Environmental Stewardship

calls.note: The foundation is reviewing which opportunities it will offer in 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Who we fund: 501(c)3 non profit organizations working in Hawaiʻi

geography.quote: Who we fund: 501(c)3 non profit organizations working in Hawaiʻi

access.quote: If your organization is eligible to apply, we will send you a link to the Kosasa Foundation portal.

window.quote: Please note the schedule of grant deadlines.

amount.quote: Grants up to $50,000 total: Requests may support projects lasting up to 18 months and must demonstrate specific, measurable environmental stewardship outcomes. Multiyear Grants up to $100,000 per year, for a maximum of $200,000 over two years

co_finance_required.quote: While it is not a requirement to have other sources of revenue for a project, your request should be reasonable relative to your operating budget and capacity.

effort.quote: Complete our short questionnaire so we can determine whether your organization is eligible to apply for the funding opportunity you've selected.
May 2027 - July 30, 2027 Community Based Environmental Stewardship *

eligibility.quote: Non 501(c)(3) organizations, endowments, debt reduction, annual galas or single-event sponsorships, organizations doing work outside the state of Hawaii, projects that re-grant Kosasa funds, religious or lobbying activities Kosasa Foundation will consider applications from organizations that serve as fiscal sponsors for other projects that do not have their own 501c3 status.
Annual grant funding from the Kosasa Foundation may not exceed 20% of the applicant organization's annual operating budget for the most recently completed fiscal year.

Non 501(c)3 organizations, endowments, debt reduction, annual galas or single event sponsorships, projects that do not benefit communities in Hawai'i, projects that re-grant Kosasa funds, religious or lobbying activites.
